why: Closure posts in this batch mix celebrating the finished work with marking that the canvas has ended, so the same concept often supports both.

why.T3-027: The concepts argue whether scripts are cheating or necessary for defense, not that scripts are run or extra accounts used.

why.T3-004: Most concepts settle the face's look, features, size and background rather than add a separate piece.
why.T3-041: The sign, Unturned text and friend are proposals to add another piece above or beside the face.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-004 carries design corrections but not the proposals to add a sign, text or friend as new pieces.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0390269 and C0067751 propose adding an r/unturned sign/text above the face, which satisfies T3-041's extension gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: If forced to one, drop T3-041; the added sign/text/friend proposals would be lost, but the item's main reshaping of the face would remain.

why.T3-014: The concepts set up and send members to a Discord for live organisation, not merely announce decisions from it.

why.T3-009: Several concepts praise and congratulate the group for holding out and for the work achieved.
why.T3-117: Other concepts announce that the canvas itself has ended and mark the close.
why.T3-029: The RIP and 'sadly we didn't get our zombie' concepts grieve the lost work.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 celebrates the work but does not carry the separate act of registering the canvas event's end.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1289273 and C0748372 mark that place is over and the event has ended, satisfying T3-117's end-marking gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: If forced to one, drop T3-117; the end announcements would be lost, but the celebration and mourning would remain.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 and T3-117 do not carry grief for the zombie as a lost work.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1430025 and C0760966 expressly mourn the lost or unsecured zombie, satisfying T3-029's mourning gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: If forced to one, drop T3-029; the grief would be lost, but the ending and celebration would remain.

why.T3-075: The concepts complain that r/place posts bury ordinary game talk and swamp the sub, not that the canvas itself is worthless.

why.T3-015: The moderator creates a megathread and repeatedly redirects event posts to it, so removals carry a gathering pointer.

why.T3-027: The concepts argue whether scripts are cheating or necessary for defense, not that scripts are run or extra accounts used.

why.T3-010: Many concepts negotiate borders, coexistence, moving or sharing space with neighbours.
why.T3-151: Other concepts explicitly trade defense and protection in return for help.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-010 settles lines and space but does not carry the reciprocal defense bargains.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0512284 offers protection in return for protection and C0772714 accepts the deal, satisfying T3-151's barter gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: If forced to one, drop T3-151; the border and coexistence material would remain, but the traded-help aspect would be lost.

why.T3-054: The single concept points members to a new place-like site after the event, which is carrying work to a later canvas.

why.T3-043: The item counts and credits who contributed and disputes how much was done, rather than only reporting one member's own placing.

why.T3-005: Many concepts are alarms, calls to defend and reports of fighting attackers for the zombie.
why.T3-021: Other concepts watch, clean and repair the face continuously without a fight call leading.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005 carries the attack alarms and calls to fight but not the routine watching and pixel-by-pixel repair.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0461854 and C0732292 ask for and describe fixing the face and constantly watching it, satisfying T3-021's upkeep gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: If forced to one, drop T3-021; the defense alarms would remain, but the repair and watchkeeping would be lost.

why.T3-014: The concepts direct joiners to a Discord channel and private contact for live organisation of the r/place work.

why.T3-009: The concepts celebrate completion and holding ground, with pride and congratulations.
why.T3-043: Other concepts credit Nelson and the group for keeping the zombie alive.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 celebrates the finished work but does not carry the specific credit to Nelson and the group.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0085851 records Nelson helping against griefers and C0953684 credits the group for keeping the zombie alive, satisfying T3-043's crediting gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: If forced to one, drop T3-043; the celebrations would remain, but the named credit to helpers would be lost.

why.T3-002: The concepts recruit and call the room's members to join and help construct the IBO mark, rather than only proposing what to make.
